title: Checkout outage after orders migration
summary: A migration locked the orders table and checkout returned 503 for 47 minutes. Expect SEV1.

input.title: Checkout outage after orders migration
input.incident:
2026-09-16 (all times UTC)
14:02 Deploy 2026.09.16-3 starts; includes migration 0412 adding an index to orders.
14:04 Migration runs CREATE INDEX (not CONCURRENTLY) on orders (180M rows); takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
14:05 Checkout API p99 latency alert fires; error rate climbs to 100% (HTTP 503) as connections wait on the lock.
14:09 On-call engineer acknowledges; suspects the deploy.
14:15 Rollback of the application started; does not help because the migration is still running.
14:31 DBA identifies the blocking CREATE INDEX in pg_stat_activity.
14:38 Decision to cancel the migration; pg_cancel_backend issued.
14:49 Lock released; checkout recovers; error rate back to 0.2%.
14:52 All clear posted.
Impact: all customers unable to place orders for 47 minutes (14:02 deploy to 14:49 recovery). Around 3,100 checkout attempts failed. No data lost; no orders duplicated.
Notes: the migration linter only runs on PRs to the schema folder; this migration lived in the app folder. The runbook did not cover blocking migrations. Status page updated at 14:20, 15 minutes after impact began.
